description.value: Noodlebox is a Canadian fast-casual franchise serving Asian-inspired wok-fired noodle and rice bowls, with a wide range of sauces from Pad Thai to Cambodian Jungle Curry. The New Westminster location is one of many BC outlets, offering dine-in and online ordering. Touring cyclists will appreciate the broad dietary accommodation, with dishes readily adaptable to vegan and gluten-friendly requirements.
